caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass oil lamp placed centrally in the composition. The lamp features a wide, ornate base that narrows into a slender neck before expanding into a round, bulbous body decorated with oval and circular patterns. The upper portion narrows slightly towards the top, where a metal fixture for the wick is attached. The lamp is rendered mainly in shades of gray with subtle highlights of blue and white to suggest reflections and transparency of the glass. The background consists of dark, vertical strokes, likely graphite or charcoal, which contrast with the lighter, shaded area around the lamp, emphasizing its form and central placement in the image. The surface on which the lamp is set is flat and lightly shaded, blending softly into the background.
title: Lamp
